title: Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records
abstract: arXiv:2611.32708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies

translated_title: 对比代理森林：从多模态记录中进行保持完备性的代理学习
translated_abstract: 近端因果推断通过使用混杂因子的两个代理变量来消除未测量的混杂：结果侧代理 W 和处理侧代理 Z。这些代理变量必须满足排除限制并且是完备的，即它们能反映混杂因子的每一个方面。在实践中，这些代理变量通常是从结构化表格中手工挑选的少数变量，然而临床笔记和生理波形信号承载着关于混杂因子的丰富信息。这类记录对于近端估计器而言维度过高，而 PCA 等通用压缩方法可能保留模态特有的变化（风格）而非混杂因子本身，从而破坏完备性。我们的关键观察是：在近端条件下，混杂因子是处理侧模态与结果侧模态之间除协变量之外的唯一联系。因此，学习两者共享的内容即可捕获混杂因子，并过滤掉模态特有的风格。对比代理森林学习两个代理变量……
tldr: 该论文提出对比代理森林（CPF），利用处理侧与结果侧模态之间由混杂因子构成的唯一联系，从高维多模态临床记录中学习共享表示以捕获混杂因子、过滤模态特有风格，从而保持代理变量的完备性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF), which leverages the fact that the confounder is the only link between treatment-side and outcome-side modalities, learning shared representations from high-dimensional multimodal records to capture the confounder, filter out modality-specific style, and preserve proxy completeness.
